ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white central regions surrounded by low-intensity black borders and a central vertical column; approximate ratio of 3:1 white-to-black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous regions occupy the interior of both lobes. Black pigmentation is concentrated along the leading and trailing edges and the peduncle transition. Symmetrical brownish mottling is present in the center-left and center-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe midlines; depth is approximately 15% of vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge shows frequent, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe trailing edge features a deep, irregular jagged indentation approximately one-third of the distance from the notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a convex trajectory along the trailing edge, curving upwards and outwards towards acute tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-intensity circular white points (barnacles) are located at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark vertical linear mark (rake or scratch) is visible on the right lobe, oriented approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal axis; additional faint brownish linear streaks across the lower-central white regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large irregular notch or potential tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive barnacle colonization on distal lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow organic staining pattern distributed across the primary white surface area of both fluke lobes.
